name: Gordunni Cobalt
summary: Orwin Gizzmick has come to Feralas seeking cobalt buried by the Gordunni ogres. He asks you to search the Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache, for twelve samples.

sections.title: Buried Minerals
sections.body:
New to Feralas, Orwin Gizzmick has heard that the Gordunni ogres bury interesting minerals. They guard the minerals fiercely, keeping them from folk like Orwin. He does not know what they want them for.

Orwin gives you a shovel and points you north of Camp Mojache to the Gordunni Outpost. Follow the blue glow and dig up twelve samples of Gordunni cobalt.

sections.title: When the Cobalt Is Delivered
sections.body: Orwin means to carry the cobalt on his further travels. He is certain someone will pay a pretty penny for it. He gives you something for your trouble.

faq.answer: Orwin Gizzmick wants Gordunni cobalt. He has just arrived in Feralas and is at Camp Mojache.
The Gordunni cobalt lies buried at the Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache.

faq.q: How do you spot the buried cobalt?
faq.answer: A blue glow marks where the cobalt is buried. Dig there to find it.

faq.q: Why do the ogres bury their cobalt?
faq.answer: Orwin says the ogres bury their cobalt and guard it fiercely to keep folk like him from getting hold of it. He does not know what they want it for.

faq.q: How much cobalt does Orwin want?
faq.answer: Orwin wants twelve samples, dug up with his shovel.
